[Zuellig Pharma](https://www.zuelligpharma.com/) is a major healthcare services and distribution company in Asia rather than a direct drug manufacturer. They partner with global pharmaceutical firms like Pfizer, MSD, and Lilly to store, commercialize, and distribute prescription medicines, vaccines, medical devices, and consumer health products across various Asian markets. [](https://sg.linkedin.com/company/zuellig-pharma)

- **Prescription Pharmaceuticals:** Cardiovascular drugs, anti-infectives, diabetes treatments, and oncology medications.

- **Vaccines:** Temperature-controlled vaccine storage and cold-chain logistics (including their eZCooler transport solutions).

- **Medical Devices & Diagnostics:**

Surgical instruments, test kits, and hospital-use consumables.

- **Consumer Healthcare:** Over-the-counter wellness products, dermatological gels, and nutritional supplements. [](https://www.scribd.com/document/475088095/ZUELLIG-PRICIPLE)

### Core Services

- **Distribution Networks:** Operating regional warehouses handling everything from ambient to frozen temperature requirements.

- **Commercialization & Licensing:** Helping international brands enter localized Asian regulatory markets and manage product portfolios.

- **Clinical Trial Support:** Managing clinical trial supply chains, patient-centric programs, and real-time inventory tracking. [](https://corporate-uat.zuelligpharma.com/segments/pharmaceuticals)
